6510fb5cefb0f023.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أبراج العاليات للمقاولات عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى صيانة الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية. متابعة تنفيذ الأعمال الكهربائية لضمان مطابقتها للمخططات والمواصفات. إعداد مخططات ومواصفات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية وتحديد مساراتها. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص الأعطال في الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات المعتمدة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات درجة جامعية في الهندسة الكهربائية أو مجال ذي صلة. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. معرفة قوية بأسس التصميم الكهربائي ومخططات شبكات النقل والتوزيع. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال وإدارة برامج الصيانة. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق شركة أبراج العاليات للمقاولات في مدينة الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بمتطلبات المشاريع الهندسية. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الكهربائيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقديم.

6565167529b404d7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة المجال العربي عن فني أجهزة إلكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب ومراقبة الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الدعم لمهندسي الإلكترونيات في أنشطة البحث والتطوير. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب ومراقبة الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، بما في ذلك الدوائر وعناصر التحكم والآلات. دراسة المخططات لتحديد نوع وكمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والميكانيكيين والحرفيين الآخرين في عمليات تركيب الأجهزة الإلكترونية. اختبار الأجهزة الإلكترونية بعد التركيب لضمان التقيد بالمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. إجراء الفحوصات الروتينية للصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص التلفيات والأعطال المحتملة، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. تقديم المساعدة التقنية لمهندسي الإلكترونيات في جهود البحث والتطوير المتعلقة بالأجهزة الإلكترونية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال فني الأجهزة الإلكترونية. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والرسومات الفنية. معرفة قوية بتركيب واختبار وصيانة الأجهزة الإلكترونية. مهارات تشخيص الأعطال واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص، ويسهم في دعم العمليات الفنية وأنشطة البحث والتطوير. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور لم يتم الإفصاح عنه وسيناقش خلال عملية التوظيف.

657d20c82f8ac0c5.description: About the Role Al Tuwairqi Group is seeking a dedicated Forklift Operator to join their team in Dammam. This full-time role involves the safe and efficient operation of a forklift, with a strong emphasis on adherence to operational procedures and daily safety inspections. The Operator will be responsible for handling materials, including billets and production scrap, while maintaining strict safety standards. Key Responsibilities Operate the forklift with extreme care and safety, strictly following established safe operation procedures. Conduct daily physical inspections of the forklift, checking engine oil, hydraulic oil, and engine coolant before operation. Implement all possible safety measures when handling billets. Drive slowly and avoid over-speeding, especially when carrying loads. Understand the Safe Working Load (SWL) of the forklift prior to operation and exercise extra caution when lifting weights at or near its SWL. Report any abnormalities immediately to the mobile workshop or direct supervisor. In the supervisor's absence, park the forklift safely, remove the key, and tag out the steering. Unload billets from trucks safely and stack them systematically with the assistance of helpers. Shift billets and other materials as per Foreman/Supervisor instructions. Display billets for cutting and charging to the mill, and charge them to the mills at the charging grid according to Supervisor instructions. Remove production scrap from various mill areas and dispose of it in the scrap yard as required and per superior instructions. Perform all tasks in accordance with ISO and CARES requirements. Safety and Compliance Understand and adhere to organizational Health, Safety, and Environment (HS&E) policies. Follow all safety instructions related to assigned jobs. Report damaged Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), unsafe machines, or equipment to the concerned staff. Maintain provided PPEs in good, workable condition. Avoid any horseplay and misuse of safety devices, equipment, and welfare facilities. Report any accidents, near misses, or hazardous conditions to the responsible party. Attend all planned safety training sessions. Exercise the right to refuse any unsafe work. Qualifications and Experience Primary School education. 1-2 years of experience in forklift operation. Work Type This is a full-time position within Al Tuwairqi Group.

65b2a44595ec9124.description: About the Role Nahdi Medical Co. is seeking an Applications Reconciliation & Data Integrity Manager to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah Region. This full-time role is responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and reliability of enterprise data flows across core business systems, including ERP, POS, payment gateways, banking platforms, and third-party applications. The manager will own the end-to-end governance, design, and operational effectiveness of financial and operational data integrations and reconciliation processes. Role Purpose and Impact The Applications Reconciliation & Data Integrity Manager ensures that all financial data movements are fully reconciled, audit-ready, and compliant with internal controls, IFRS requirements, and IT governance standards. This position acts as the enterprise authority for data reconciliation, integration controls, and data integrity assurance across applications, supporting critical business processes such as financial close, reporting, taxation, and operational analytics. Key Accountabilities Own and govern the enterprise-wide integration and reconciliation framework across all financial and operational systems. Ensure end-to-end integrity of data flows between ERP, POS, payment gateways, banking systems, and third-party applications. Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of integration architecture, reconciliation models, and data validation rules. Oversee all financial reconciliation processes including sales-to-GL, bank reconciliation, POS-to-ERP reconciliation, AP/AR, VAT, inventory valuation, and intercompany transactions. Ensure timely detection, investigation, and resolution of data discrepancies, integration failures, and posting errors. Define and enforce data integrity standards, reconciliation policies, and control frameworks aligned with internal audit, ITGC, ISO 27001, and IFRS requirements. Act as the escalation point for critical data integrity and integration issues impacting financial close and business reporting. Ensure readiness and accuracy of month-end and year-end close processes by validating all financial integrations and reconciliations. Drive automation of reconciliation and integration monitoring using SQL, ETL tools, APIs, and data validation scripts. Develop and maintain dashboards and KPI reporting for data integrity, reconciliation accuracy, and system performance. Lead governance of integration tools and platforms (*, Oracle ARCS, middleware, ETL solutions), ensuring optimal usage and control. Collaborate with Finance, Treasury, Tax, Internal Audit, and IT teams to ensure alignment on data integrity and reconciliation standards. Support audit processes by providing evidence, documentation, and traceability of reconciliation controls and integration flows. Own Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical data and integration incidents and ensure corrective/preventive actions are implemented. Continuously enhance data reconciliation and integration capabilities through adoption of automation, AI-based anomaly detection, and data observability tools. Maintain documentation of integration architecture, reconciliation rules, control matrices, and data lineage. Experience Required Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience. Work Environment and Schedule This is an indoor role, with 100% of work performed within an office environment. The work schedule is 5 days a week, with 2 days off. Working hours are from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, including a one-hour break.

65d8071de7119f59.description: About the Role Saudia Dairy & Foodstuff Company (SADAFCO) is seeking a Credit Controller to join their team in Jiddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves assisting the Credit Control Manager in maintaining and enhancing the company's credit control system to ensure timely collections, working closely with the Sales department. Key Responsibilities Review and update company credit control policies and procedures in liaison with sales and finance management, ensuring adherence by all departments. Provide periodic financial reporting to management, including regional cash collection forecasts, actual collections, and aged debtor analysis. Assist the sales department in analyzing and preparing collection forecast reports to facilitate proper follow-up on pending collections. Manage outstanding sales balances, contact customers before payments become overdue, and initiate necessary proceedings to resolve outstanding debts. Develop and maintain strong relationships with key customers through regular visits. Perform rebate calculations and apply new Business Development Agreement (BDA) changes to monthly bookings. Conduct timely reconciliations of customers' accounts to ensure completeness of records and efficient collection processes. Support the Credit Control Manager by providing all required information related to Accounts Receivable (AR) for external audits. Review and evaluate customers' credit limits to ensure accuracy based on their historical payment behavior. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in a relevant credit control or finance role. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia.

65d931cc13fcb76e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قادة الفعالية للخدمات التجارية عن مهندس تقنية معلومات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تلبية احتياجات العملاء من الأجهزة والبرمجيات، وتطوير الأنظمة، وتشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير الفنية المتخصصة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة احتياجات العملاء من الأجهزة الحاسوبية وبرمجياتها وتلبيتها بفعالية. متابعة وتقييم عملية جمع وتحليل البيانات، وتطوير أساليب التحليل والتصميم بناءً على التقييم. البحث عن أحدث وسائل وأدوات البرمجة والفحص والتركيب المناسبة، ومراقبة دورة تطوير البرمجيات. تطوير وفحص وتركيب التجهيزات الحاسوبية والبرمجيات لضمان الأداء الأمثل. تشخيص أعطال التجهيزات الحاسوبية والبرمجيات ومعالجتها بكفاءة. تطوير برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة تنفيذها لضمان استمرارية العمل. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية المستمرة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وعرض نسب تقدمها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال تقنية المعلومات أو دور مشابه. فهم قوي لاحتياجات الأجهزة والبرمجيات الحاسوبية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الفنية وتقديم الحلول المناسبة. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية. نوع العمل والموقع هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التواجد في الموقع للتعامل مع التجهيزات والبرمجيات بشكل مباشر. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

652d009a725dbcc5.description: About the Role Diyar United Company is seeking an ICS/OT Information Security Architect to join their team in Al Khafji. This full-time position involves designing, implementing, and overseeing cybersecurity architecture and controls within Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and Operational Technology (OT) environments. The role requires a professional with 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Design and oversee cybersecurity architecture specifically for ICS/OT environments. Develop and implement OT security controls, policies, standards, and procedures. Assess OT/ICS networks, systems, and infrastructure to identify cybersecurity risks and vulnerabilities. Apply recognized OT cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and ISO/IEC 27001. Ensure alignment with applicable Saudi National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) OT cybersecurity requirements, including NCA OTTCC. Collaborate with IT, OT, engineering, infrastructure, and operations teams to implement secure architectures. Support risk assessments, security reviews, vulnerability management, incident response, and cybersecurity improvement initiatives. Review and guide the implementation of network segmentation, firewalls, monitoring, access control, and other OT security controls. Provide technical guidance on OT cybersecurity architecture, solutions, and projects. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in information security, with a focus on ICS/OT environments. Demonstrated expertise in designing and implementing cybersecurity architecture for industrial control systems. Proficiency in developing and applying OT security controls, policies, and standards. Familiarity with relevant cybersecurity frameworks such as IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and ISO/IEC 27001. Understanding of Saudi National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) OT cybersecurity requirements, including NCA OTTCC. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khafji, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic environment focused on securing critical industrial control systems.

65c4a26d7b2e3422.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن مراقب خدمات عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على مراجعة وتنسيق أنشطة موظفي الخدمات العامة، وتطوير إجراءات العمل، ومعالجة المشكلات التشغيلية لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف مراقب الخدمات العامة إلى الإشراف على عمليات الخدمات العامة، وتحسين الأداء، وتنمية مهارات الموظفين. يشمل ذلك تحديد المهام والواجبات، وتطوير برامج العمل، واقتراح حلول للمشكلات، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير الدورية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة وتنسيق أعمال وأنشطة موظفي الخدمات العامة، وتحديد مهامهم وواجباتهم بناءً على حجم العمل والأولويات وقدرات العاملين. إعداد وتطوير برامج وإجراءات العمل، وتنسيق الأنشطة مع الوحدات التنظيمية الأخرى ذات الصلة. دراسة مشكلات العمل، وتحديد أسبابها، واقتراح بدائل الحلول الممكنة، واختيار الحل الأنسب، ومتابعة التنفيذ والتقييم. تقييم أداء موظفي الخدمات العامة ومدى التزامهم باللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بمجال العمل. تحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية الفردية للموظفين وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على مراجعة وتنسيق الأنشطة التشغيلية. مهارات في إعداد وتطوير إجراءات العمل. القدرة على تحليل المشكلات واقتراح الحلول. مهارات تقييم الأداء وتحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في المنطقة الشرقية، وتتطلب التفاعل المستمر مع موظفي الخدمات العامة والوحدات التنظيمية الأخرى لضمان تحقيق الأهداف التشغيلية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة سراكو.

65ffd6714480a2c5.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مصنع صافيه لمياه الشرب المعباه عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقه في الرياض. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. سيقوم المحاسب بإعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية، ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات، وتسجيل العمليات المحاسبية لضمان دقة السجلات المالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في هذا المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال محاسبة النفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات. مهارات في إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية. القدرة على تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في التعامل مع البيانات المالية. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحليل الإيرادات والنفقات. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المالية وحفظها. مهارات تنظيمية لإدارة المستندات والسجلات المحاسبية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مصنع صافيه لمياه الشرب المعباه. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل احترافية تدعم النمو المهني. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. نشجع المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على التقديم.

651dee583bf6339a.description: Company Overview: Nutrili is a leading and rapidly growing wellness brand based in Riyadh and Dubai, redefining what supplements can be. We specialize in science-backed supplements, from gummies and collagen to essential vitamins, designed to help people take control of their health. But we didn’t stop at efficacy. Supplements shouldn’t feel like a chore; they should be something you look forward to. That’s why we crafted delicious supplements with the perfect consistency, housed in award-winning packaging (winner of the 2023 A' Packaging Design Award) that deserves a place on your vanity or bedside table, not hidden in a cabinet. At Nutrili, we’re on a mission to make nutrition simple, enjoyable, and empowering. And we’re looking for a motivated self-starter to join our ambitious team. Job Overview: The Strategic Partnerships & Marketing Growth Associate will be responsible for building, managing, and growing Nutrili’s strategic offline partnerships. You will work across two major areas: Strategic Partner Growth: Supporting key partners to improve sell-through, visibility, staff education, activations, reorder opportunities, and customer feedback loops. Wellness, Corporate & Community Partnerships: Building partnerships with gyms, clinics, wellness studios, beauty destinations, hotels, corporate wellness clients, events, and community partners that help Nutrili reach the right audience and drive measurable growth. The ideal candidate is not just “good with people.” They are commercially sharp, structured, proactive, and able to manage partners, activations, reporting, and follow-up with discipline. Key Responsibilities: 1. Strategic Partner Growth Manage and support priority partners after listing. Build account plans for strategic partners, including visibility, activations, staff education, product focus, and growth opportunities. Support sell-through by coordinating in-store activations, product education, sampling, POS material, and partner-specific campaigns. Collect store and partner feedback on product performance, customer objections, pricing, merchandising, and reorder opportunities. Work closely with sales and commercial teams to identify which partners and locations need more support. Track partner performance, activation impact, stock movement feedback, and opportunities for improvement. Ensure key partners understand Nutrili’s products, benefits, usage, and positioning. 2. Partnerships & Business Development Identify and develop new partnerships across gyms, Pilates/yoga studios, wellness centers, clinics, beauty salons, aesthetic clinics, hotels, spas, corporate wellness teams, universities, and premium lifestyle communities. Build and maintain a structured partnership pipeline with clear opportunity value, next steps, owners, and deadlines. Develop partnership proposals that align with Nutrili’s brand, audience, and commercial objectives. Negotiate partnership opportunities, activations, sampling plans, corporate wellness offers, workshops, and co-branded initiatives. Build long-term relationships with high-potential partners rather than one-off collaborations only. 3. Activations, Events & Trade Marketing Plan and execute in-store activations, wellness pop-ups, sampling days, corporate wellness sessions, retail partner events, and community activations. Ensure every activation has a clear objective, target audience, budget, expected outcome, and post-event report. Coordinate with marketing, content, design, sales, and logistics teams to make sure events and activations are executed smoothly. Be present on the ground when needed to manage partners, setup, product displays, sampling, customer questions, and issue resolution. Capture learnings from each activation and recommend what to repeat, improve, pause, or stop. 4. Retail & Partner Feedback Loop Collect recurring feedback from partners, store teams, and customers. Identify common product questions, objections, education gaps, and merchandising issues. Share insights with marketing, product, sales, ecommerce, and leadership. Recommend improvements to POS material, product education, FAQs, retail training, product bundles, partner messaging, and activation formats. Help Nutrili understand which partnerships are truly valuable and which are not worth continuing. 5. Reporting & Performance Tracking Maintain a weekly partnerships and retail growth tracker. Report on partner pipeline, meetings, proposals, activations, leads, sampling, sell-through feedback, reorder opportunities, and blockers. Prepare post-activation reports including objective, cost, audience reached, leads collected, sales or reorder impact where available, customer feedback, and next steps. Track partnership outcomes against clear KPIs, not just activity. Provide leadership with clear recommendations on where Nutrili should invest more time, budget, and team effort. What This Role Owns Strategic partner support Partner relationship management Retail activation planning and execution In-store sampling and staff education coordination Wellness, corporate, clinic, gym, and community partnerships Partnership pipeline management Partner feedback and customer insight reporting Activation performance reporting Reorder opportunity identification Weekly partnerships tracker You will work closely with these teams, but your role is to build and grow partnerships that create measurable brand and commercial value. Success Looks Like Strategic partners are better supported after listing. Store teams understand Nutrili products and can explain them clearly. Activations are planned, executed, and reported with discipline. High-potential partners are identified and developed into repeatable growth channels. Partnership activity leads to measurable outcomes: sales, leads, reorders, sampling, visibility, customer insights, or brand credibility. Leadership has a clear weekly view of the partner pipeline, active opportunities, blockers, and recommended next actions. Requirements Saudi National Network in Riyadh across retail, wellness, beauty, fitness, clinics, hotels, or corporate wellness is a strong plus. 3–6 years of experience in partnerships, business development, trade marketing, retail account management, brand activations, or key account growth. Experience in wellness, beauty, supplements, FMCG, pharmacy, consumer health, hospitality, fitness, or premium lifestyle brands is preferred. Strong relationship-building and negotiation skills. Commercial mindset — able to connect partnerships to revenue, sell-through, leads, customer acquisition, and brand growth. Strong execution skills and comfort managing activations end-to-end. Ability to work independently in a fast-paced startup environment. Strong organization and follow-up discipline. Comfortable using Google Sheets, trackers, reports, and basic performance dashboards. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong understanding of premium consumer brands and Saudi customer behavior. Willingness to travel for partner meetings, retail visits, activations, and events. You may be a strong fit if you have worked in: Beauty or wellness retail partnerships Consumer health brand activations Premium brand partnerships Retail partner success Corporate wellness partnerships Fitness or lifestyle partnerships Strategic account management for a consumer brand You should be someone who can say: “Here is the partner pipeline, here is the opportunity, here is what we activated, here is what converted, here is what we learned, and here is what we should do next.” Why Join Nutrili Join one of the GCC’s fastest-growing wellness brands. Work directly on partnerships that shape how customers discover and experience Nutrili. Be part of a young, ambitious, fast-moving team. Help build the next stage of Nutrili’s retail, wellness, and strategic partnership engine. Play a meaningful role in making nutrition simple, enjoyable, and empowering.

657e5afb6ca77e39.description: ADREE is seeking a Software Technical, Senior Engineer with a strong software development background to provide technical leadership, drive engineering best practices, and support the delivery of scalable, reliable, and high-quality software solutions. The role combines hands-on software development with technical leadership, mentoring, architecture, and collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Lead the technical execution of software development initiatives and ensure alignment with business and technical requirements. Translate business requirements into scalable and effective technical solutions. Design and contribute to system architecture, including microservices, distributed systems, and APIs. Make technical decisions related to application design, development, performance, and scalability. Develop and maintain high-quality, production-ready software while remaining hands-on with coding. Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to engineering standards, coding best practices, and quality guidelines. Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and other stakeholders to define technical solutions and delivery approaches. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and support their technical and professional growth. Provide technical guidance to the engineering team and support effective problem-solving and decision-making. Support technical roadmap planning, estimation, prioritization, and delivery planning. Drive the adoption and effective use of CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms. Identify and address system performance, scalability, reliability, and security concerns. Participate in incident management, troubleshooting, and on-call rotations when required. Promote Agile/Scrum practices and contribute to continuous improvement within the engineering team. Support conflict resolution and facilitate effective technical discussions within the team. Balance hands-on development responsibilities with team leadership and technical coordination. Experience Requirements Minimum 7 years of professional software development experience. At least 2–3 years in a technical leadership, senior engineer, or team lead capacity. Proven track record of delivering production systems at scale. Experience mentoring or managing a team of engineers (typically 3–8 people). Technical Skills Strong proficiency in at least one primary language (e.g., Java, Python, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#). Deep understanding of system design and architecture (microservices, distributed systems, APIs). Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Solid grasp of databases (SQL and NoSQL), caching, and data modeling. CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and orchestration (Kubernetes). Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation) is a plus. Strong understanding of security best practices and performance optimization. Experience with version control workflows (Git) and code review processes. Leadership & Soft Skills Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Experience conducting code reviews and enforcing engineering best practices. Strong communication skills — able to work with product managers, designers, and stakeholders. Ability to mentor junior/mid-level engineers and support their growth. Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies. Conflict resolution and decision-making skills. Ability to balance hands-on coding with team leadership responsibilities. Additional Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience). Experience with technical roadmap planning and estimation. History of driving architectural decisions and technical strategy. Experience with incident management and on-call rotations. Contributions to open source or technical writing/blogging (nice to have). Job Location: HQ

65d8c74419e500bb.description: We are looking for an E-Commerce & Marketplace Operations Executive to manage the day-to-day operations of our e-commerce store and marketplaces, including Zid, Amazon, Trendyol, and other sales channels . The role will be responsible for the full order lifecycle — from receiving and processing orders to fulfillment, shipping, delivery, inventory coordination, and resolving operational issues. The ideal candidate should be highly organized, hands-on, and capable of coordinating effectively between the warehouse, branches, customer service, marketplaces, and logistics partners. Key Responsibilities E-Commerce & Order Fulfillment Manage and monitor daily orders through the Zid Dashboard . Review and process incoming orders and ensure they are ready for fulfillment. Manage the complete order lifecycle from order receipt to picking, packing, shipping, and delivery. Coordinate Picking, Packing & Order Fulfillment with the warehouse team. Monitor pending and delayed orders and take immediate action to resolve issues. Handle operational issues related to missing items, incorrect orders, cancellations, exchanges, and returns. Ensure orders are processed and shipped within the required turnaround time. Marketplace Operations Manage daily operations across Amazon, Trendyol, and other marketplaces . Process and monitor marketplace orders according to each platform’s requirements and SLA. Ensure order and shipment statuses are updated accurately. Monitor marketplace cancellations, returns, delayed orders, and fulfillment issues. Coordinate inventory availability across the website and marketplaces. Identify and resolve operational issues that may negatively impact marketplace performance. Coordinate issues related to SKUs, barcodes, product mapping, and inventory synchronization . Inventory & Branch Coordination Monitor inventory availability across the e-commerce store and marketplaces. Coordinate with the warehouse and branches to ensure stock availability. Manage and follow up on stock transfers and replenishment between the warehouse and branches . Monitor low-stock and out-of-stock items and escalate when replenishment is required. Identify and resolve discrepancies between physical and system inventory. Ensure accurate SKU and barcode mapping across all sales channels. Shipping & Logistics Operations Manage daily operational coordination with courier and logistics partners. Ensure orders are assigned to the appropriate shipping provider. Monitor AWB creation, shipment pickup, delivery, and shipment status . Follow up on delayed, failed, or returned shipments. Coordinate with couriers, warehouse, and customer service teams to resolve delivery issues. Monitor recurring shipping problems and escalate them when required. Operations Control & Reporting Ensure accurate and timely order status updates across all systems and marketplaces. Conduct daily follow-ups on pending, delayed, and exception orders. Coordinate between E-Commerce, Marketplaces, Warehouse, Branches, Customer Service, and Logistics . Prepare operational reports covering order fulfillment, delays, cancellations, returns, and operational errors. Identify recurring operational issues and implement corrective actions. Recommend process improvements and automation opportunities to increase efficiency and reduce manual work. Requirements 2–4 years of experience in E-Commerce Operations, Marketplace Operations, Order Fulfillment, or a similar role. Hands-on experience in order processing, inventory management, fulfillment, and logistics operations. Experience with Zid is highly preferred. Experience with Amazon Seller Central and other marketplaces is preferred. Good understanding of Order Fulfillment, Inventory Management, and Marketplace Operations . Familiarity with SKU management, barcodes, inventory synchronization, and stock transfers . Good knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets . Strong organizational, follow-up, and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage a high volume of orders and coordinate across multiple teams. Strong attention to detail and ability to take ownership of daily operations. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) On-Time Fulfillment Rate Order Accuracy Marketplace SLA Compliance Pending & Delayed Orders Order Cancellation Rate Inventory Accuracy Stock Availability Return & Failed Delivery Rate Issue Resolution Time Overall Operational Efficiency

65b3776d7d444a21.description: ERAM Talent is seeking an experienced Research & Development (R&D) Engineer – Beverages . The successful candidate will be responsible for developing innovative beverage formulations, improving existing products, conducting pilot trials, and supporting factory-scale production. This role requires strong expertise in beverage formulation, sugar reduction technologies, and functional ingredients. Key Responsibilities Develop and formulate new beverage and liquid products based on market trends and customer requirements. Improve existing beverage formulations to enhance taste, quality, nutritional value, and production efficiency. Lead sugar reduction initiatives using alternative sweeteners while maintaining product taste, texture, and stability. Develop formulations incorporating functional ingredients such as vitamins, minerals, proteins, and fibers. Conduct laboratory trials, bench-top formulations, and pilot-scale testing. Lead factory scale-up activities and support the successful transition from laboratory development to commercial production. Evaluate thermal processing methods, including pasteurization, to ensure product quality and ingredient stability. Select and evaluate raw materials and identify suitable alternatives when required. Provide technical support during new product launches and production trials. Train production teams on processing requirements for new formulations. Troubleshoot manufacturing issues such as sedimentation, phase separation, flavor degradation, and color changes. Work closely with Quality Assurance to ensure compliance with food safety and regulatory standards. Conduct shelf-life studies, stability testing, and maintain complete technical documentation. Bachelor's degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, or a related discipline. 5+ years of hands-on R&D experience in the Beverage or Liquid Food Manufacturing industry. Proven experience in beverage formulation and product development. Strong knowledge of functional ingredients and their stability in liquid applications. Demonstrated experience in sugar reduction projects and alternative sweeteners. Experience with pilot plant trials and factory-scale production. Sound understanding of pasteurization, beverage processing, and food safety standards. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Excellent documentation and communication abilities. Preferred Experience Experience in juice, flavored beverages, dairy beverages, functional drinks, or similar liquid food products. Exposure to cost optimization and product reformulation projects. Familiarity with international food safety and quality management systems.
